cg.basis: Typical 2WD pickup, unladen. No ESS measurement. —  Indicative range 22–28.

grip.basis: 1970s street radial (tire-type default; see acceleration validation).

cda.basis: Typical pickup Cd 0.40–0.50 × 28–38 ft² frontal area. —  Indicative range 12–19.

frontSpring.basis: Spring giving a typical 1.1 Hz front ride frequency (truck).

rearSpring.basis: Spring giving a typical 1.3 Hz rear ride frequency (truck).

frontMotion.basis: Short/long arm (double wishbone, upper/lower A-arms). Typical ranges for the architecture; motion ratio = spring travel ÷ wheel travel. Unsprung = per corner incl. wheel, tire, brake, half the links (live axle: half the axle). —  Indicative range 0.5–0.7.

rearMotion.basis: Live axle, leaf springs. Typical ranges for the architecture; motion ratio = spring travel ÷ wheel travel. Unsprung = per corner incl. wheel, tire, brake, half the links (live axle: half the axle). —  Indicative range 0.9–1.

frontUnsprung.basis: Short/long arm (double wishbone, upper/lower A-arms). Typical ranges for the architecture; motion ratio = spring travel ÷ wheel travel. Unsprung = per corner incl. wheel, tire, brake, half the links (live axle: half the axle). —  Indicative range 80–110.

rearUnsprung.basis: Live axle, leaf springs. Typical ranges for the architecture; motion ratio = spring travel ÷ wheel travel. Unsprung = per corner incl. wheel, tire, brake, half the links (live axle: half the axle). —  Indicative range 110–170.

tireRate.basis: Typical tire vertical rate for the vehicle type. —  Indicative range 1000–2400.

weight.basis: 1978 Chevy truck specs — 1978 C10 short bed. GM Heritage lists its 1975 C-10 at 3,649 lb (src-205).

front.basis: Layout class "fr-truck": 2 pickups: 1967 F-100 factory 2,010/1,450 lb (58.1%) and 2022 Silverado ZR2 test (56%). Low confidence.. —  Indicative range 0.55–0.61.

diameter.basis: No tire size on record: typical diameter for the vehicle type. —  Indicative range 24–31.

archFront.basis: Mapped from the record's suspension text: "Independent short/long arm with coil springs" / "Live axle with leaf springs".

archRear.basis: Mapped from the record's suspension text: "Independent short/long arm with coil springs" / "Live axle with leaf springs".
